visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Generalize the Three-Digit Formula
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The digits are pulled out with fixed divisors and cubed by hand, which only works for three-digit numbers. Write an isArmstrong method that works for any number of digits (use the same range 100 to 999 so the output stays the same).

solution.explanation: A loop over the digits replaces three hard-wired variables, so the same method works for 4-digit numbers like 9474 and for any other length. Logic that hides a fixed assumption (here: 3 digits) is a bug waiting for new input.
